feedback: The confession follows the established two-location opportunity and the impossible live feed, and it confirms my chosen explanation without introducing a new scientific trick or previously unavailable witness. Saved-image presentation is a reasonable consequence of the sample-image and unpowered-camera facts. The actual theft and dosing are newly admitted acts, rather than new independent evidence. Emotionally the admission about selling work others still had to build fits Elon's earlier shame and funding pressure. Elle and Monet receive credible consequences for their lesser wrongdoing rather than instant absolution. I find the ending earned as a plausible resolution, although it resolves uncertainty by confession more than by proving why other accessible suspects could not have killed.
